text_block_list.text:
Мэдзиро Райан runs with all her might in
the spring
Tenno Sho, and with her
victory, she puts a stop
to Mejiro
McQueen's ambition.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Though frustrated by defeat, McQueen

congratulates Ryan on her win.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Now that Ryan is the one ahead, she
declares
herself ready to take on any
challenge from
McQueen.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Her next goal is the spring race that
decides the
medium-distance
champion—the Takarazuka
Kinen. If she
does well, then her ranking in the fan

poll is sure to rise!
text_block_list.name: Монолог
